'''Gilles Sartoris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Sartoris was a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and a [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] addict, who regularly beat his son [[Jareth Sartoris]]. However, one day when Jareth was sixteen, Gilles went to beat his son and Jareth turned on him, killing his father. Jareth then dumped his father's body in a local alleyway. Jareth proceeded to leave and join the Empire.<ref name="Death Troopers">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>
